items.text: Uniform Cell: no second persisted semantic shape or side authority.
Authority coherence: no active contradiction; mutable facts are generated.
No hidden interpreter: graph path and any fast path are equivalent; deleting the fast path does not alter meaning.
One identity: every lens resolves the same roots and facts.
Explicit causality: rewiring authority changes behavior; deleting projection does not.
Persistent attention: signals, reasons, focus, obligations, and cursors recover after restart.
Replay: graph state reconstructs deterministically and effects do not repeat.
Attention security: hidden roots cannot influence visible output or context.
User control: a nontechnical user can understand cause, edit permitted state, undo, and recover without Floor knowledge.

Composition: group, enter, breadcrumb, ungroup, and undo preserve identity and connectivity.

Core Values: each value maps to a passing control or visible gap; no partial row is green.

No false done: report exact revision, environment, evidence, open requirement, residual risk, and untested boundary.
